'''Dredin''' was a disreputable [[Accountant/Legends|accountant]] who often used first-generation [[A2 Accounting/Business Unit]]s for business, skimming [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] from customers' accounts and later blaming the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] processing defect for any detected errors.
